name: company-kernel
description: A headless company-state kernel for humans and agents.

interface.shortDescription: Keep company context explicit and current
interface.longDescription: Create and reconcile a project-local company model, evaluate concrete opportunities, and resolve market unknowns without installing strategy bureaucracy.
defaultPrompt: Use $company-model to create or reconcile the shared company model.
Use $opportunity-evaluate to decide whether this opportunity belongs in the company.
Use $market-probe to resolve this company-shaping market unknown.
